compiled_state.description:
Implement plugins/dso/scripts/commit-step.sh to make T1 tests pass.

## Implementation logic
1. Parse <name> argument (first positional arg); exit 1 if absent
2. Source plugins/dso/hooks/lib/deps.sh; ARTIFACTS_DIR=$(get_artifacts_dir); mkdir -p "$ARTIFACTS_DIR"
   - CONSISTENCY REQUIREMENT: must use get_artifacts_dir() from deps.sh (same as pre-commit-compliance-verifier.sh) so both scripts read/write the same directory
   - WORKFLOW_PLUGIN_ARTIFACTS_DIR env var override is handled automatically by get_artifacts_dir()
3. Run the underlying command (remaining args after <name>); capture stdout, stderr, exit code
4. If exit_code == 144: write $ARTIFACTS_DIR/<name>.timeout (JSON: {step, timestamp, reason: 'exit_144_timeout'})
5. Else: write $ARTIFACTS_DIR/<name>.result (JSON: {step, exit_code, stdout, stderr, timestamp})
6. Append breadcrumb to $ARTIFACTS_DIR/steps.log (JSON Lines: {step, exit_code, timestamp})
7. Exit with the command's original exit code (pass through)

## Post-implementation
chmod +x plugins/dso/scripts/commit-step.sh

## Classification
GREEN — implement to make T1 tests pass
